summary: Frontend-only verification of two targeted fixes on SecureFin: (1) password eye icon convention and (2) scroll-triggered entrance animations with prefers-reduced-motion support. All specified test cases PASS. No regressions observed in login flow or sidebar navigation.

tests_executed.password_toggle_login: PASS - initial: type=password + EyeOff (lucide-eye-off); after click: type=text + Eye (lucide-eye); after 2nd click: back to password + EyeOff
tests_executed.password_toggle_reset: PASS - forgot flow triggered → reset mode with development_token auto-populated → password field also follows convention (EyeOff hidden, Eye visible)
tests_executed.login_regression: PASS - admin@securefin.app / SecureFinAdmin!2026 → redirects to /app dashboard, sidebar renders Overview/Transactions/Investments/Subscriptions/Budgets/Analytics/Security center/Profile/Settings
tests_executed.scroll_triggered_animations: PASS - Before scroll, below-fold sections ('Everything important', 'Three steps to a clearer', 'Your financial data deserves') have opacity=0 and transform matrix(1,0,0,1,0,30) i.e. hidden state y=30px. After scrolling each into view, opacity animates to 1. Above-fold hero animates in on initial load as expected.
tests_executed.reduced_motion: PASS - With emulate_media(reduced_motion='reduce'), all sections render at opacity=1/transform=none on load (no scroll needed), cursor-aurora elements count is 0 (CursorTrail returns null).

critical_code_review_comments: App.js is 358 lines with heavy inlining (AuthPage on a single ~250-column line). Consider splitting into per-feature files for maintainability — noted but out of scope for this bug-fix pass.
RevealOnScroll & DashboardPreview correctly use useInView({once:true, amount:0.2, margin:'0px 0px -80px 0px'}); reduced-motion branch returns plain <div> avoiding motion state — good.
Password toggle at App.js line ~283 correctly maps: showPassword ? <Eye/> : <EyeOff/> matching standard UX convention.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both requested fixes are verified working end-to-end on the live preview URL. Password toggle uses lucide-react classes lucide-eye-off (hidden) vs lucide-eye (visible). Scroll-triggered reveals confirmed via computed opacity/transform before vs after scroll_into_view. Reduced-motion respected globally.
